name: Aquera — Governance Aggregation Bridge
positioning: Delta-based aggregation bridge that imports changed compliance/governance data from apps into identity governance platforms for faster aggregation.

evidence.text: The bridge detects account changes (deltas)... sends only the deltas to the identity governance platform for aggregation processing.
The account data includes all the attributes and entitlements needed to fully analyze the identity access governance and compliance posture.

traps_counters.counter: Policy accuracy benefits from near-real-time freshness with explicit lineage and an inventory graph for decision enrichment

notes: Delta detection, multi-protocol ingest (file/JDBC/API/RPA) claimed; verify SLAs and lineage mechanisms during POC.
